objective: Abrir Gate12K sin reabrir Gate12J. Auditar exclusivamente la readiness de implementacion backend para vincular CavaSocios_Socios.PersonaID con Gobierno_Persona y, cuando corresponda, Gobierno_PersonaVinculo/Cliente_Catalogo. Definir contrato exacto de servicio, transaccion, identidad SQL de usuario, endpoints, RBAC, idempotencia, desvinculacion controlada y compatibilidad legacy antes de cualquier MUTATION. No crear tablas, no DDL/DML, no modificar codigo, no crear permisos nuevos, no matching automatico por NombreCompleto/Email/Telefono, no tocar Produccion.

queries.name: identity_guard
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS db_user,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login;

queries.name: cava_persona_link_state
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_persona,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_persona FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios;

queries.name: persona_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_personas FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona;

queries.name: persona_vinculo_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_vinculos FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo;

queries.name: cliente_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_clientes FROM dbo.Cliente_Catalogo;

queries.name: persona_link_fk
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name,OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND fk.name=N'FK_CavaSocios_Socios_GobiernoPersona';

queries.name: persona_vinculo_uniqueness
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.has_filter,i.filter_definition,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo') AND i.is_unique=1 ORDER BY i.name;

queries.name: usuario_catalogo_identity_types
queries.sql: SELECT c.name AS column_name,TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS type_name,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Usuario_Catalogo') AND c.name IN (N'UsuarioID',N'PublicUUID') ORDER BY c.column_id;
